hero.headline: The best habit tracking apps in 2026.
hero.subline: There are dozens of habit apps out there. Here's an honest look at what works, what doesn't, and where Momentum fits in.

sections.heading: What to look for in a habit tracker
sections.body: Not all habit trackers are created equal. Some are glorified to-do lists. Others bury you in gamification. The best ones share a few traits: simplicity, visual feedback, flexibility in scheduling, and — crucially — support for the behaviour-science principles that actually drive change (cues, stacking, environment design).

sections.heading: The problem with most habit apps
sections.body: Most apps treat habits as checkboxes. Did you do it? Yes/No. But that misses the entire mechanism. Where's the cue? What comes before and after? What's the reward? Without these elements, you're relying on pure willpower — and research shows that doesn't last.

sections.heading: Where Momentum is different
sections.body: Momentum is built on the full habit loop. You don't just add a habit name — you define the cue, the environment, what you stack it after, and what the reward is. Your day is laid out in time slots, your week is visualised colour-coded, and every feature is designed around proven behaviour-science principles, not gamification gimmicks.

sections.heading: Free during beta
sections.body: While Momentum is in active development, everything is completely free. No premium tier locked behind a paywall, no ads, no data selling. Just a clean, fast, privacy-respecting habit tracker built by a developer who actually uses it every day.
